The bare onboarding config merged in #64 enabled the gomod manager
against the whole repo, and Renovate immediately opened #65 -- go 1.22
-> 1.26.8 plus gnark-crypto v0.13.0 -> v0.22.0 in exactly that
directory. That is the bump the spec reserves for a human, and it lands
on a native BN254 shim with its own build.sh and native-build workflow.
The root go.mod is left managed: it declares the module and a go
directive with no require block, so there is nothing there to get wrong.
JVM dependencies (build.mill, .mill-version) belong to Scala Steward --
see .scala-steward.conf. No guard is needed for them here because
Renovate has no Mill manager, so the two bots cannot collide on them.
